hypothesis: A training-free selector that expands from seed objects along question-implied relation hops can remove at least 50% of scene objects while retaining answer-critical bridge/support objects much better than seed-only or KNN pruning.
acceptance_sanity: >=50% reduction, >=99.9% seed coverage, >=90% support recall, >=30 pp full-retention gain vs KNN
acceptance_real: >=50% reduction and real QA drop <=1 pp vs full scene, or real QA improves with meaningful reduction
